title: 電動車電池模組組裝
summary: 從來料追溯到低能量圖面檢查，分開電壓拓撲、接點品質、熱路和絕緣資料。
summaryEn: Follow incoming traceability to low-energy schematic checks, separating voltage topology, contacts, thermal paths and insulation evidence.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 電池串並聯電壓：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Battery series/parallel voltage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 電池串並聯電壓 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Battery series/parallel voltage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為電芯串列、匯流排與模組壓緊件。串聯累加電壓，並聯增加容量；實際可用範圍由單顆電芯極限與保護策略決定。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows cell strings, busbars and module compression members. Series connection adds voltage and parallel connection adds capacity; actual operating limits depend on cells and protection.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：Vpack=Ns Vcell；Ns=96、Vcell=3.7 V；計算結果=355.2 V。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Vpack=Ns Vcell; Ns=96, Vcell=3.7 V; result=355.2 V.
steps.failure: 串數漏算與單顆電壓異常不同；核對拓撲及每串讀值。
steps.failureEn: Missing series cells differ from abnormal cell voltage; check topology and individual readings.
steps.check: 名義355.2 V；不能用名義值取代最高電壓與隔離驗證。 將此判讀連回電芯串列、匯流排與模組壓緊件的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Nominal voltage is 355.2 V; it cannot replace maximum-voltage or insulation assessment. Relate this interpretation to cell strings, busbars and module compression members and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
